Description:
SyncTogether is the desktop watch party app designed for friends, families, and communities to watch movies, shows, and videos in frame-accurate sync.

Whether you're watching a local 4K movie file or streaming the latest YouTube video, SyncTogether keeps play, pause, seek, and audio tracks frame-locked across every participant's screen. Enjoy seamless shared playback combined with low-latency facecam video rails, crystal-clear voice chat, and lively animated emoji reactions.

KEY FEATURES

• FRAME-PERFECT MEDIA SYNCHRONIZATION
Clock synchronization continuously keeps everyone's playback aligned. When anyone pauses, skips forward, or seeks to a new chapter, everyone’s screen reacts in lockstep, without drift.

• WATCH LOCAL FILES OR YOUTUBE
Open and synchronize local video containers (MP4, MKV, WebM, AVI, MOV) directly from your hard drive with hardware-accelerated decoding. Or simply paste a YouTube URL to stream synchronized online videos without third-party browser extensions.

• REAL-TIME FACECAM RAILS & VOICE CHAT
See your friends' live reactions right beside the theater screen. Integrated low-latency video and spatial voice chat let you laugh, comment, and react together just like you're sitting in the same living room.

• INTERACTIVE CHAT & ANIMATED REACTIONS
Send real-time chat messages and burst vibrant animated Lottie emoji reactions across the screen during peak movie moments.

• PRIVATE, ZERO-HASSLE ROOM CODES
Create rooms with unique 6-character room codes (e.g., X7K9P2) or one-click invite deep links (synctogether://join/CODE). No messy network configuration, port forwarding, or complicated setups required.

• CLOUD MEDIA SHARING (OPTIONAL)
If friends don't have the video file downloaded locally, hosts can upload and stream their file directly into the room with built-in cloud media streaming.

• GUEST MODE (ZERO SIGN-UP REQUIRED)
Your friends can join any watch party instantly as a Guest with a single click. No account creation, passwords, or credit cards needed to start watching.

• FOR COUPLES & LONG-DISTANCE
Pair two accounts and get Our Room, a free private room that is always yours. Plan date nights across time zones with a reminder before they start, build a weekly streak, keep your history, count down to your reunion and share a year card. Pairing is free for any two signed-in accounts.

• MODERN THEATER DESIGN
Crafted with a distraction-free dark cinema aesthetic. Enjoy a shared viewing experience that stays out of your way while watching full-screen content.

SyncTogether makes movie nights across distances feel truly together.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
TIERS, SESSION LIMITS & OPTIONAL IN-APP PURCHASES
----------------------------------------------------------------------
SyncTogether is free to download and use. We offer a Free Plan and Guest Mode with defined session limits, as well as an optional Patron subscription for extended functionality.

1. GUEST MODE ($0 / No Account Required):
• Room Session Limit: Up to 60 minutes per session.
• Participant Limit: Up to 4 participants per room.
• Features: Text chat and basic emoji reactions. (Voice and video facecams are disabled in Guest Mode).
• Room Lifetime: Temporary rooms that close immediately when empty or when the 60-minute session concludes.

2. FREE PLAN ($0/month - With Free Account):
• Room Session Limit: Up to 4 hours per room session (includes one free 60-minute extension per session).
• Participant Limit: Up to 8 participants per room.
• Active Rooms: Up to 4 active rooms hosted simultaneously.
• Audio & Chat: Real-time low-latency Voice chat, text chat, and animated reactions. (Free rooms include one 10-minute facecam trial; ongoing video needs a room hosted by a Patron).
• Media Sharing Quota: 2.5 GB rolling 7-day upload quota (up to 2.0 GB per individual file). Uploaded quota recharges automatically 7 days after completion.
• Room Lifetime: Rooms hibernate for 24 hours after a session ends, allowing you to rejoin and resume playback where you left off.

3. OPTIONAL PATRON PLAN (Subscription):
Users who require extended watch party sessions and high-capacity rooms can optionally upgrade to SyncTogether Patron:
• Subscription Options: Available as an optional auto-renewing subscription with Monthly and Annual billing options (with discounted annual pricing). Current pricing in your local currency is always clearly presented in-app and at checkout before any transaction is initiated.
• Extended 24-Hour Sessions: Continuous room duration up to 24 hours per session (extended from the 4-hour free limit).
• Ultra-Low Latency Video Facecams: Full camera video rails with speaking indicators for all participants.
• Expanded Capacity: Up to 16 participants per room (expanded from the 8-member free limit).
• Unlimited Media Sharing: Unlimited weekly upload quota (up to 10.0 GB per individual file).
• 20 Persistent Vanity Rooms: Permanent, custom room codes that never expire or delete.
• Pairs: If either partner is a Patron, both can plan date nights and see their full history, with shared video facecams in Our Room.
• Shared Host Perks: When a Patron member hosts a room, all joining members (including Free and Guest users) enjoy the host's 24-hour duration, expanded capacity, and video facecam perks for that session.

ReleaseNotes:
FOR COUPLES & LONG-DISTANCE
• PAIR WITH YOUR PARTNER: Connect two accounts and you get your own private room, free, that's always open for the two of you.
• DATE NIGHTS: Plan a movie night even across time zones. Each of you sees it at your own local time.
• YOUR STREAK & HISTORY: Watch together each week to build your Our streak, and look back at everything you've watched.
• REMINDERS: Get a notification when your partner is ready or a date night is about to start.
• NICKNAMES & COUNTDOWN: Give each other nicknames and count down the days until you meet.
• OUR YEAR CARD: A shareable summary of your year together.
• FILM STAYS PUT: After a shared film ends, it stays in your room, so you can pick it up again.

EVERYTHING ELSE
• SMOOTHER LOOK: Times, dates and counters now move only where the numbers change, so the app feels calmer.
• NEW DATE & TIME PICKER: Choosing a date or time looks and feels like the rest of the app.
• BACK WITH ESC: On desktop, press Esc to go back.
• FIXES: Shared videos stream more reliably. The badge list scrolls properly, and the profile buttons work as they should.
